description: A Bash shell library script used to set up and configure testing environment for Bash completion scripts. It detects the current shell environment and sources an external library for additional functions.

methods.name: exec bash "$0" "$@"
methods.description: Re-executes the script using Bash to ensure full Bash mode when not already in Bash.

methods.name: test -n "$BASH" && test -z "$POSIXLY_CORRECT"
methods.description: Checks if the current shell is Bash and not POSIX-compliant mode.

methods.name: type bash >/dev/null 2>&1
methods.description: Checks if the 'bash' command is available in the environment.

methods.name: echo '1..0 #SKIP skipping bash completion tests; bash not available'
methods.description: Outputs a test skip message if Bash is not available.
